## Checklist

- [ ] Skill lives in `skills/<name>/` with a `SKILL.md` entrypoint
- [ ] `name` matches the directory; `description` is specific and trigger-rich
- [ ] Frontmatter has `name` + `description` (validated by CI against `skill.schema.json`)
- [ ] Any bundled scripts are POSIX-clean (`shellcheck` passes)
- [ ] Links work and Markdown lints clean
- [ ] README catalog table updated if a skill was added/renamed
